title: Oven-Roasted Welsh Orange Cake
description: A moist citrus cake with a caramelized orange crust and a molten center, perfect for family snack time.
instructions: Preheat oven to 180°C and line a 20cm square pan with parchment.
In a bowl, whisk together flour, baking powder, salt, and protein powder until well combined.
In a separate bowl, cream softened butter and sugar until light and fluffy.
Beat in eggs one at a time, then stir in Greek yogurt and orange juice until smooth.
Gradually fold the dry ingredients into the wet mixture, then stir in orange zest.
Pour batter into the prepared pan and smooth the top with a spatula.
Bake for 25 minutes, then remove and let cool slightly before slicing.
Serve warm with a scoop of vanilla ice cream or a drizzle of honey.
Optional: dust with powdered sugar before serving.
Store leftovers in an airtight container for up to 3 days and reheat briefly.
